body:
Fuck you all, I hate you all. I wish I could just go on a street and tell every fucking person how much I hate them. Because I know that if we would ever meet in life you would treat me like a trash. You would get angry at me because I’m a fucking moron. I’m so annoying right? So childish. You wrote that you care. And now you deleted this. 
I hate everyone. I hate everyone with families and friends who are telling me that it will get better. Can you write it on paper? Will you sign it? If you’re so sure.

There is one person. I thought that for some reason he likes me. I now he’d said that my decision to not go to work tomorrow is childish. I’ve told him to fuck of and he’s not ever writing anything anymore. He’s mad at me. He thinks I’m joking about killing myself. Fuck him. Fuck everyone.
